_doc: Example mapping for tools/replay_real_jds.py. Keys under 'fields' are JobOps fields; values are the column (CSV) or key (JSON, dotted paths allowed) in your export. Only 'title' is required; omit any field your export does not have. 'id' names the source field used as posting_id (optional). 'records_key' is the JSON key holding the list when the file is an object, not a list. company_type values: product, ai_native, gcc, enterprise, staffing, consultancy, it_services, engineering_led, third_party_payroll.
